_comment: ObsiLauncher runtime manifest (v2). 'defaults.mirrors' are ordered mirror BASE directories for the downloadable Internal-* JRE packs; the gate hands them to the installer verbatim. Mirrors are tried per file in order, so a CDN that refuses a big file (e.g. jsDelivr's size cap on jre-25/universal.tar.xz) transparently falls through to the pinned raw source. Layout: <mirror>/<jre-id>/<part> — parts are universal.tar.xz + bin-arm64.tar.xz, unpacked into runtime/Internal-<java>/. The Zalith component store is pinned to commit fe5853b5bcd872c93e0dba558890a744aaaec9f2 so downloads survive upstream churn.
